_comment: Provenance and filters for one price import run.
Fetch the payload first, then import it, so the exact bytes can be
archived and re-verified against the recorded artifact digest:
include_models is deliberately explicit. The upstream file carries close
to three thousand entries; a wholesale dump is not a reviewable source
record, and pinning the exact keys makes a model appearing or vanishing
upstream a visible diff rather than a silent change.
Prices move. retrieved_at and retrieved_at_epoch_ms must be updated on
each run; the import appends a new time-bounded offering revision rather
